name: Fluid Functionalism
summary: MIT shadcn registry of spring/hover React components (Radix + Base UI flavors).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 47 registry:ui items (71 total registry entries including themes/libs/hooks).
Radix flavor used for pilot; Base UI alternate at @fluid/base/{slug} / r/base/{slug}.json not listed separately.
Stock shadcn filenames overlap — CLI may need --overwrite.
Font-weight animations expect Inter variable font with wght+opsz axes.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Animated button with fluid font-weight hover and variants.

demo.peerNotes: Free MIT via shadcn registry @fluid. Radix flavor is default; Base UI via @fluid/base/{slug}. May need --overwrite on stock shadcn files. Inter variable font recommended for weight animations.

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @fluid/button
# or: npx shadcn@latest add https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/r/button.json
# First: npx shadcn@latest registry add @fluid
# Use --overwrite if replacing stock shadcn files.

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use Fluid Functionalism free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest registry add @fluid` then `npx shadcn@latest add @fluid/button` (or `npx shadcn@latest add https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/r/button.json`). Default flavor is Radix; Base UI via `@fluid/base/button`. Import from `@/components/ui/button`. Peers include framer-motion / motion springs, lucide-react, Tailwind, shadcn tokens. Home: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com. Docs: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs. Repo: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Micka Touillaud). Pricing free.
